title: The Hundredth Floor
author: TechnoBen
description:
You and your sister get trapped in a VRMMO and your goal is to get to the 100th floor alive.

Can you clear the game or will you die on your way to the hundredth floor?

Features:

- Character customization
- Hunger and fatigue system
- A wardrobe based inventory system
- A housing system
- NPCs that can be partied up with
- Crafting
- Cooking
- Being able to work jobs (at inns and stuff)
- A system where the floor boss can be defeated by other players if you take too long
- A few side stories
- Being able to pet dogs
- Achievements
- Different gamemodes
- Multiple minibosses
- 2 floors (with a 3rd floor in the makings)
